sections.content:
GradMax: Growing Neural Networks using Gradient Information
Evci et al. | ICLR 2022
This fixture summarizes a real paper about adding neurons during training.
GradMax grows a network without disturbing learned behavior and initializes
new weights to maximize useful gradients through an SVD-based procedure.
The paper reports improved training dynamics across several vision settings.

sections.content:
Growing Tiny Networks: Spotting Expressivity Bottlenecks and Fixing
Them Optimally
Verbockhaven et al. | TMLR 2024
This fixture captures a real paper on growing small networks during training.
The method detects expressivity bottlenecks from backpropagation signals and
adds neurons where the current architecture cannot follow the functional gradient.
The paper reports CIFAR results that match larger models with less manual search.

Firefly Neural Architecture Descent: a General Approach for Growing
Neural Networks
Wu et al. | NeurIPS 2020
This fixture summarizes a real paper on dynamic architecture growth.
Firefly descent expands width or depth by searching a functional neighborhood
around the current network with a Taylor-based greedy selection rule.
The paper targets accurate and resource-efficient models, including continual learning.

sections.content:
AutoGrow: Automatic Layer Growing in Deep Convolutional Networks
Wen et al. | KDD 2020
This fixture summarizes a real paper on automatic depth discovery.
AutoGrow starts from a shallow seed network, grows layers when accuracy improves,
and stops when additional depth no longer helps under the learned policy.
The paper reports strong accuracy-computation trade-offs across several datasets.

sections.content:
Growing Neural Networks Achieve Flatter Minima
Caillon and Cerisara | ICANN 2021
This fixture summarizes a real paper on optimization and generalization.
The paper studies networks that add neurons incrementally during training and
compares the minima they reach against fixed-size models trained from scratch.
The reported result is that the grown models converge to flatter minima and generalize better.
